learning_outcomes.text: To provide information on engine types, operation of internal combustion engines, fuels, classifications, parts, uses, and cycles.
To teach size, power, and efficiency calculations.
To provide brief information about Hybrid and Electric vehicle systems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, definition of engines, basic concepts
Engine types: Wankel, Stirling, Jet engines
Engine Fuels, Combustion, 4-stroke engines and their operation
Engine Fuels, Combustion, 4 and 2-stroke engines and their operation. Ideal cycles and thermal efficiency
Working principles of gasoline and diesel engines, real cycle times (intake and compression times)
Real cycle times (combustion-expansion and exhaust times)
Comparison of cycles. Deviations from the ideal cycle
Fuel systems and mixture formation in gasoline engines
Fuel systems and mixture formation in gasoline engines. Engine emissions and control techniques
Fuel systems and mixture formation in diesel engines
Fuel systems and mixture formation in diesel engines. Hybrid and Electric vehicle technologies
